title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (August, 2026)
summary: August 2026 cumulative updates are released for Business Central across versions 28, 27, and 26, with version 28.4 for 2026 Release Wave 1 now available in both cloud and on-premises deployments. The post includes support timeline information and lifecycle details for multiple BC versions from 2019 through 2026.
key_points: Version 28.4 (BC28 CU04) released for 2026 Release Wave 1 with Platform 28.0.53289.0 and Application 28.4.53241.53312 in cloud
On-premises update 28.4 available with Platform 28.0.53152 and Application 28.4.53241
Multiple cumulative updates released: BC27 CU10 and BC26 CU16 for earlier waves
2026 Release Wave 1 support runs from April 1, 2026 to October 13, 2027
Multiple older versions (BC25 through BC13) marked as end of life with defined retirement dates
features: Production and Sandbox Environment Management in Admin Center

quotes.text: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key capability in the cloud version that allows administrators to manage multiple environments in a centralized location
